joe-turners-come-and-gone-2026.title: Joe Turner's Come and Gone
joe-turners-come-and-gone-2026.notes: The 2026 Broadway revival of August Wilson's 'Joe Turner's Come and Gone', directed by Debbie Allen and starring Taraji P. Henson and Cedric the Entertainer, opened April 25, 2026 at the Ethel Barrymore Theatre and is scheduled to close July 26, 2026 after two extensions. The RainMakers Collective sold an investment memo targeting accredited investors, referencing a 'structured path to recoupment' and comparing the production to recent Wilson revivals, but no specific capitalization figure, weekly running cost, or recoupment data is explicitly stated in the available evidence. No SEC filings or trade-reported financial figures were found.

the-balusters-2026.title: The Balusters
the-balusters-2026.notes: The Balusters is a new play by David Lindsay-Abaire, directed by Kenny Leon, produced by Manhattan Theatre Club at the Samuel J. Friedman Theatre (MTC's Broadway house) as part of their 2025-26 season. No financial data — capitalization, weekly running costs, or recoupment — is explicitly stated in any of the evidence provided. As an MTC production at their nonprofit Broadway venue, standard commercial recoupment metrics do not apply in the same way. The show received five Tony nominations according to Broadway Journal coverage.
